_meta.citation: SatPM2.5 V6GL03, Atmospheric Composition Analysis Group, Washington University in St. Louis, via the AWS Registry of Open Data (registry.opendata.aws/surface-pm2-5-v6gl). CC BY 4.0. Method: van Donkelaar et al., Environ. Sci. Technol. 2021, doi:10.1021/acs.est.1c05309
_meta.sampling: nearest grid cell to metro centroid; where that cell is the -999 ocean/no-data fill, the mean of the nearest valid square neighbourhood
_meta.limitation: centroid sample, not area- or population-weighted over the metro boundary
_meta.precisionNote: stored to 4 dp to preserve rank order, which 2 dp destroys by manufacturing ties. This is the model's grid precision, NOT measurement accuracy: round to 1 dp for display.
_meta.omitted: metros outside the raster latitude band (-59.95..69.95) are omitted rather than clamped to an edge row
